metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: ★ 2.4 · 2026 · Money Trap: The Karun Treasure
metas.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

metas.name: 2026 · Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: 2026 · The Incomer
metas.description: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

metas.name: ★ 9.4 · 2026 · Wanted
metas.description: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · The Informant
metas.description: Tae-bong, an informant in a smuggling operation, gets exposed during his mission. Meanwhile, bumbling detective Nam-hyuk stumbles into the chaos while attempting his own scheme. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two must recover their losses and take down the criminals.

metas.name: 2026 · Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Therapy Done Right
metas.description: A renowned psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional therapy, begins to secretly intervene in his patients' lives, achieving remarkable results - until a creatively blocked writer enters his practice.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2026 · The Storm
metas.description: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be tra...

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A romantic comedy about Nam Da Reum, who joins a company led by former idol-turned-CEO Lee Chan, and unexpectedly finds herself in a romance with the company's boss, Kang Ha Gi.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Pennum Porattum
metas.description: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2016 · Rostered On
metas.description: "Rostered On" is an independent Australian comedy show based around the day to day struggles of working for a faceless retail corporation "Electroworld".

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Jailer 2
metas.description: A retired officer's peaceful life is disrupted when a dangerous criminal organization threatens his family. He must use his skills one final time to protect his loved ones and preserve his legacy.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Dhoomakethu
metas.description: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.
